address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the device. Defaults to `0x4D`.

*See also: [PCM5122](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/pcm5122#configuration-variables)*

analog_gain.docs:
**enum**: The analog output gain applied by the PCM5122. One of `0db` or `-6db`. Defaults to `0db`.

*See also: [PCM5122](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/pcm5122#configuration-variables)*

bits_per_sample.docs:
**enum**: The bit depth of the audio samples. One of `16bit`, `24bit`, or `32bit`. Defaults to `16bit`.

*See also: [PCM5122](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/pcm5122#configuration-variables)*

left.docs: Left channel data to both outputs.

right.docs: Right channel data to both outputs.

channel_mix.docs:
**enum**: How audio channel data is routed to the left and right outputs. One of:

*See also: [PCM5122](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/pcm5122#configuration-variables)*

enable_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: GPIO pin connected to the PCM5122's XSMT (soft mute) pin. Held low during `setup()` and driven high once initialization succeeds. Omit if XSMT is hardwired high.

*See also: [PCM5122](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/pcm5122#configuration-variables)*

i2c_id.docs:
The ID of the [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c) the PCM5122 is connected to.

*See also: [PCM5122](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/pcm5122#configuration-variables)*

volume_max_db.docs:
**dB**: The volume level that maps to the maximum volume (fully turned up). Must be greater than `volume_min_db`. Range: `-103.0dB` to `24.0dB`. Defaults to `0dB`.

*See also: [PCM5122](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/pcm5122#configuration-variables)*

volume_min_db.docs:
**dB**: The volume level that maps to the minimum volume (fully turned down). Must be less than `volume_max_db`. Range: `-103.0dB` to `24.0dB`. Defaults to `-52.5dB`.

*See also: [PCM5122](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/pcm5122#configuration-variables)*
